text.tspan: Replay shall observe the exact configured native AEB intervention diagnostic tuple.
Replay shall preserve ordered MRM transition, emergency-gate selection, and simulator-response observations with their source and collector stamps.
Missing, contradictory, identity-mismatched, or unreplayable evidence shall not produce a passing outcome.
Reviewer question: What physical hardware, software, and mechanical
elements make up the candidate system, and in which internal roles
Evidence-based assurance claims and their supporting argumentation.
Reviewers need claims, arguments, evidence, and gaps linked
in an assurance argument for the increment.
